era: The 2016-2020 www1.nyc.gov design every visitor saw in 2019: 'The official website of NYC' strip, NYC logo, a bordered top nav (NYC Resources, NYC311, Office of the Mayor, Events, Connect, Jobs) with search, NYC Today date panel, news and events carousels, and a grey footer (Directory of City Agencies, Contact NYC Government, City Employees, Notify NYC, CityStore, Stay Connected, NYC Mobile Apps, Maps, Resident Toolkit, Privacy Policy, Terms of Use). 2019-03/07/11 home HTML and the 2019-03 311 page HTML agree.
